construction: JWS General JSON Serialization, RFC 7797 unencoded detached payload, EdDSA/Ed25519
notes: Fixed inputs named by a label are SHA-256(UTF-8("agora-test-vectors/" || label)), truncated to the stated length.

CBOR maps are encoded with RFC 8949 section 4.2.1 core deterministic key order and preferred integer widths. The spec does not require this order; it is one valid encoding, and receivers use the bytes as received.
Protected header member order and the JSON text of `sig` are as shown; the spec fixes neither, and verifiers use the received `protected` value. All JSON is compact.
Header negatives: the signature is a valid Ed25519 signature over that entry's own signingInput, so rejection must come from the header checks, not the signature check.
The guardian body is an abbreviated Space state proposal, not a complete Space state document; it exercises the signature-set rules only.
DID resolution is out of scope: each entry gives the public key its kid resolves to.

vectors.name: two-signer-serviceagreement
vectors.reason: both required signers (provider and billing) present, §10.5.1

vectors.name: negative-missing-required-signer
vectors.reason: ServiceAgreement requires provider and billing entries; provider entry missing. The billing entry itself is cryptographically valid.

vectors.name: threshold-2-of-3-valid
vectors.reason: entries from 2 distinct candidate DIDs, threshold 2, §4.1 / §13.1.1

vectors.name: negative-threshold-duplicate-did
vectors.reason: two entries whose kids name the same DID (g1, two different keys); both signatures are cryptographically valid, but only 1 distinct DID < threshold 2 and duplicate DIDs MUST be rejected, §13.1.1

vectors.name: admission-key-registration
vectors.reason: signed by the agreement's billing DID, §10.5.3; agreement = bodyCidText (CID of the ServiceAgreement body bytes) of two-signer-serviceagreement; keys[0] is a rotation with replaces = the keyEpoch 0 token

vectors.name: channel-admission-key
vectors.reason: signed by the Space owner, §3.4; seed is the rotated admission key of admission-key-registration (keyEpoch 1)

vectors.name: broadcast-key
vectors.reason: signed by the Space owner, §3.4; used by broadcast-payload.json

vectors.name: negative-b64-absent
vectors.reason: b64 member absent while crit still lists it (§13.1.1 check 2)

vectors.name: negative-b64-and-crit-absent
vectors.reason: b64 and crit absent: an ordinary b64=true JWS header (§13.1.1 check 2)

vectors.name: negative-crit-absent
vectors.reason: b64 false but crit absent (§13.1.1 check 2; RFC 7797 section 6)

vectors.name: negative-cty-mismatch
vectors.reason: header cty application/cbor, envelope contentType application/json (§13.1.1 check 2)

vectors.name: negative-agoratype-mismatch
vectors.reason: header agoraType urn:agora:type:ServiceAgreement, envelope type urn:agora:type:RelayAd (§13.1.1 check 2)

vectors.name: negative-reserialized-body
vectors.reason: signature made over the compact body (signedBodyHex); the envelope carries the same JSON re-serialized with 2-space indentation, so check 5 fails (§13.1.1 byte-for-byte rule)
